title: A choice without its required question can reach Pi
detail: cli-jev lists -q/--question as required for choice (.skilled/skills/cli-classifier/cli-jev/references/cli-reference.md:40-48). The parser initializes question to empty and rejects only when no option keys exist (.skilled/skills/cli-classifier/shared/scripts/jev-transport.mjs:91-92,126-127); spawnClassifierCall routes any parsed request through Pi preflight (.skilled/skills/cli-classifier/shared/scripts/jev-transport.mjs:528-545). A supported choice with options but no question can therefore be sent to Pi in automatic mode instead of keeping Jev's usage error. The parser tests do not cover this shape (.skilled/skills/cli-classifier/shared/scripts/tests/jev-transport.test.mjs:191-202). Confirmed by following the static branch conditions.

title: Optional env omission disables Pi discovery
detail: spawnClassifierCall documents env as optional (.skilled/skills/cli-classifier/shared/scripts/jev-transport.mjs:507-509) but substitutes {} when it is omitted (:511-512). Pi discovery reads PATH only from that env object and defaults to an empty string (.skilled/skills/cli-classifier/shared/scripts/jev-transport.mjs:291-304), and the same object is used for route/preflight (:528-545). Following that branch, an omitted env gives Pi no PATH entries and prevents discovery of the process-installed package. The shared test helper always supplies env (.skilled/skills/cli-classifier/shared/scripts/tests/jev-transport.test.mjs:124-132). Confirmed by static branch analysis; not reproduced by running code.
